tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Read every comment on an HTMLAnnotate page: what each reviewer said, which element it is pinned to (with a CSS selector), the screen size, the page version it was left on, suggested text changes and replies. Use it when the user asks what their client said, or wants you to make the requested changes

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a reply under one comment on an HTMLAnnotate page, as the page owner. Everyone in that thread gets an email. Confirm the wording with the user first. To change a comment's status instead, use resolve_comment or set_comment_status.

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a comment on an HTMLAnnotate page as resolved (done), or reopen it. Use after the requested change has been made. Everyone in the thread gets an email when it is resolved. To set it to in progress, or change its priority, labels or assignee, use set_comment_status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.htmlannotate.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_html, share_url, get_comments, update_page, get_comment, get_page_html, list_versions, set_comment_status, update_page_settings · Private data: share_html, share_url, get_comments · Public sink: share_html, share_url, reply_to_comment, resolve_comment, get_page_html, get_health_check, restore_version, update_page_settings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_html, share_url, get_comments, update_page, get_comment, get_page_html, list_versions, set_comment_status, update_page_settings · Private data: share_html, share_url, get_comments · Public sink: share_html, share_url, reply_to_comment, resolve_comment, get_page_html, get_health_check, restore_version, update_page_settings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
